answer_1.quote: We explore writing Wikipedia-like articles from scratch, which demands a pre-writing stage before producing the article.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the outline quality...we define metrics for evaluating the outline quality against human-written articles.

answer_3.quote: We use Prometheus, a 13B evaluator LLM to score the article based on a 5-point rubric collaboratively developed with two experienced Wikipedia editors.

answer_4.quote: We further invited a group of experienced Wikipedia editors for expert evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Each pair of articles is assigned to 2 editors. We request editors to judge each article from the same five aspects...using a 1 to 7 scale.
